description: A dark blue wool Sturgian kaftan over a cream linen shirt, with restrained brown fur edging at the collar and cuffs. Fine pale geometric embroidery borders the front, sleeves and hem, and two small round metal brooches fasten the upper coat. A brown-and-cream woven sash ties the waist with hanging fringed ends. Loose brown wool trousers tuck into tall brown leather boots. The practical opaque layers show noble workmanship without headgear, armor or weapons.
